meta.title: Retail: the till and the online shop · Clafina
meta.description: A till that keeps selling when the internet drops, an online shop on the same stock, and a Z report that closes the day. Built into Clafina.

hero.title: One stock, one price list, the till and the shop.
hero.lede: A till that keeps selling when the line drops, and an online shop on the same stock and prices.

business.name: Adaeze Home and Electronics
business.about: A homeware and small electronics shop with two branches, three tills and an online shop.

dayTitle: A day at Adaeze Home and Electronics

moments.title: Opening the till
moments.problem: Chiamaka starts her shift. The drawer has to start from a known float, or the evening count means nothing.
moments.handles: She signs in to the till with her PIN, not an office account, and counts the float note by note. The shift starts from that number.

moments.title: The line goes down with a queue at the counter
moments.problem: The internet drops at the busiest hour.
moments.handles: The till keeps selling. Every sale is written on the till first and sent when the line is back, within the offline limits the office set for each product, payment type and number of hours.

moments.title: A regular pays two ways
moments.problem: Mrs Okafor wants to use her points and pay the rest in cash.
moments.handles: Chiamaka finds her by phone number, sees her points, store credit and wallet, and splits the payment. Points are earned on the part paid in cash.

moments.title: An online order for something on the shelf
moments.problem: A customer orders a blender on the shop while another is looking at one in the branch.
moments.handles: The shop and the till sell the same stock at the same prices. The order arrives as a sales order tagged with the shop, and the two can't both sell the last unit.

moments.title: A kettle comes back
moments.problem: A customer returns a kettle bought last week by card.
moments.handles: The return becomes a credit note and a refund, paid back the way the sale was paid. The kettle goes back into stock.

moments.title: Two tills sold the last one
moments.problem: While the line was down, both tills at Ogui Road sold the last blender.
moments.handles: Both sales stand. The manager sees an oversold exception in plain words, with a button to transfer one from Garden Avenue, which has six.

moments.title: A new banner for the weekend
moments.problem: Adaeze wants the weekend offer on the shop's front page.
moments.handles: She changes the banner in Storefront Studio as a draft, previews it and sends it for approval. Once it's published, a bad change can be rolled back.

moments.title: Is the cash right?
moments.problem: Closing time. The drawer has to match the day.
moments.handles: Chiamaka counts the drawer. The till shows the difference from what it expects, or hides it on a blind close, and prints the Z report. Adaeze sees the shift and the difference from her desk.

sharesTitle: What it shares with the rest of Clafina

shares.text: Every sale moves stock once, at the branch that sold it. The shop sells from the same count.
Each till sale is posted as an invoice and a receipt; returns become credit notes.
Cash, card and transfer land in their own accounts, and gift cards are kept as money owed.
Customers found or made at the till, with points, store credit and credit limits.

modulesTitle: The parts of Clafina a shop uses

faq.q: What happens when the internet goes down?
faq.a: The till keeps selling. Each sale is written on the till first and sent when the line is back. You decide how much of each item a till may sell offline, and for how long.

faq.q: Can the shop and the till sell the same stock?
faq.a: Yes. They sell from the same count at the same prices, and an online order arrives as a sales order tagged with the shop.

faq.q: What if two tills sell the last one while offline?
faq.a: Both sales stand. The manager sees it in plain words, with a button to move stock from a branch that has it.

faq.q: Do I need an industry pack for a shop?
faq.a: No. The till and the online shop are built into Clafina. Packs such as Restaurant or Events add to the same till.

faq.q: Can I sell in cartons and single items?
faq.a: Yes. The till sells in more than one unit, so a carton, a pack and a single item each have their own price.
